description:
Hi,

I hope you are doing good.

I have a job opportunity related to your profile with one of our client, please find below Job Description for your review. If you are interested and available for the following position then please send your updated resume in word format along with your contact details to discuss further.

 Role: Technology Analyst - Java (Healthcare Domain)
Duration: Full TIme
Location: Hartford, CT

Qualifications
 Basic 
• Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required. Will also consider three years of relevant work experience in lieu of every year of education
• At least 2 years of experience with Information Technology.

 Preferred
 • At least 2 years of experience in Java/J2EE Technology and Frameworks.
• At least 2 years of working experience on different J2EE frameworks like Struts, Spring MVC, etc.
• At least 2 years of experience in development tools like Eclipse, WebSphere application server, etc.
• At least 2 years of experience in software development life cycle.
• At least 2 years of experience in translating functional/non-functional requirements to system requirements.
• Experience and understanding of in Production support and performance engineering.
• Ability to work in team environment and client interfacing skills.
• Analytical skills to identify root cause and come up with solutions/alternatives
• Experience in HealthCare domain
• Hands on experience on Web Services – SOAP and/or RESTful
• Experience in any of the Database, writing queries/procedures like DB2/Oracle/SQL Server, etc.
• Experience in Waterfall and Agile projects
• Experience and desire to work in a Global delivery environment

About Client:
A Global IT consulting firm with several large customer engagements across US. It provides strategic business consulting, technology,engineering and outsourcing services to help clients leverage technology and create impactful and measurable business value for every IT investment.

About Us:
Avance Consulting Services is a global talent acquisition and executive search company. We work exclusively with some of the most reputed and admired clients across various sectors and geographies. This is a very urgent role. Apply NOW with your updated resume in word format


 • Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required. Will also consider three years of relevant work experience in lieu of every year of education



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
